prompt: Implement the dot product of two equal-length vectors, the workhorse of machine-learning math. Complete the dot method in the starter file.
explanation: The dot product multiplies vectors element by element and sums the results; it is the core operation behind neuron activations, similarity scores, and linear models. A single indexed for loop over both arrays with a double accumulator is all it takes. Starting the accumulator at 0.0 handles the empty-vector case for free.
hints: Loop one index i over 0 .. a.length-1; both arrays share that index.
